what_happened: Layout 4, red-white Straw010, GlassCup025. Stage 0 at 222. Straw grasped 338-359 and lifted 0.74 m (width 0.013); navigation was slow (labeler 369-976; the robot reached the cup only at ~1100-1140; successes arrive ~600-700). 1140-1344 (~200 steps) the straw was held vertically above/beside the cup; around 1260 it appeared to be right over the opening, but it never touched the cup (at_target never held). At ~1344 the gripper drifted and tilted, and it released at 1350 with the straw centre 5.9 cm from the cup; the straw dropped onto the counter beside the cup (end 6.4 cm, z 0.925). The arm then left; no retry.
causal_chain: late arrival at the cup (~1140) -> ~200 steps hovering over/beside the opening without lowering it in -> drifted and released 6 cm off (1350) -> straw on the counter -> no retry until timeout
official_criterion_notes: Official success = straw touches the cup AND straw centre < 0.5 m horizontally from the cup centre AND gripper far; there is no 'inside' or upright test, so a straw lying across the rim or leaning on the outside of the cup would count once the gripper leaves. Straw tilt fields are relative to the straw lying flat: 'tipped_over' (>45 deg) here means the straw was held or standing vertical, not that it fell over. The tipped_over interval ends at 1095 although the straw is still held near-vertical in the video until ~1344, so the tilt field is unreliable for this thin object.
uncertain_about: Whether the straw was ever above the opening in depth; the agent view suggests so at ~1260 but there was no contact.
